resources.string: No app on this device can open the link.
EtherPK could not receive every file. A share can hold up to 20 files and 100 MB, and each file must still be available in the app you shared from.
The login was interrupted. Log in again from EtherPK.
EtherPK needs Android System WebView 144 or later, and this device has an earlier version. Your notes are not affected. Update Android System WebView, then open EtherPK again.
EtherPK stopped several times in a minute, so it was not opened again. Your saved notes are not affected. If this device is low on memory, close other apps before you open EtherPK.
